title: Enterprise shared pool to paid overage
summary: Exhaust the Enterprise tenant's large shared AI-credit pool, then show paid usage flowing into metered budgets.

steps.title: Consume most included credits
steps.description: Alice consumes 665,000 of the Enterprise shared pool's 666,000 included credits.
steps.expected: The event is accepted from included credits, no paid overage is created, and 1,000 pooled credits remain.

steps.title: Exhaust the shared pool
steps.description: The remaining 1,000 included credits are consumed.
steps.expected: The Enterprise shared pool reaches 100%, while metered cost remains $0.

steps.title: Create paid overage
steps.description: A further 1,000 credits can no longer use the Enterprise shared pool.
steps.expected: The event is accepted as 1,000 metered credits and creates $10 of paid overage.
